positive_controls.argument: Actual consequence, retention and authority requirements identify which engineering knowledge must remain recoverable and current.
The actual assurance and reproducibility need determines which items, evidence and promotion authority require explicit configuration treatment.
The real decision and external obligation identify which correspondence must be demonstrated and retained.
The actual consequence and retention requirements identify which records, approvals and obligations the change may invalidate.
The consequential boundary and its retention or assurance needs identify the interface knowledge and decision rights that require durable control.
The actual obligation and decision use identify which verification evidence and rationale must be retained and govern its authority.
Configuration and decision-use requirements make explicit which integrated claim the retained evidence must support.
Actual retention, authority and consequence requirements define the useful trace scope and prevent indiscriminate link collection.
The actual audience, authority and retention needs specify the context and accountable decision that the assurance argument must support.
Actual consequence and authority requirements identify which exception history and residual decision must be retained.
Decision use, retention, authority and proportionality determine what the model environment must preserve and who may rely on it.
The consequence, retention and authority needs define which pipeline outputs matter, how long they remain useful and who may consume them.
